description: We’re the Apogeans, a team from Muscat hooked on one question: where on Earth can we practise living on the Moon and Mars? We’re using NASA data to match future base sites with real places here, like deserts, craters and ice fields, even Oman’s own Dhofar desert. Apogee is the highest point of an orbit, and that’s where we’re aiming. Other worlds. Found here.
